name: usb
description: Capture and decode USB traffic on this machine: smart-card readers (CCID/APDU), HID devices, and mass storage (MSC/SCSI). Offline .pcapng analysis needs no special privileges.

dumpcap_path.description: Optional dumpcap path for live capture on Linux. Empty means detect it from PATH and common install locations.

usbpcap_cmd_path.description: Optional USBPcapCMD.exe path for live capture on Windows. Empty means detect it from PATH and the Wireshark install directory.
